Root cause: the formula residual is 0 or 1 of 255 in every row of the pre-fix replay, so src/variants.ts recolor is exact, as the Red says. The ball used k.tint(slot, 0.03 + 0.05 * sheen) and the kite used k.tint(slot, 0.10) on the upper sail. A positive shade adds white in linear light, and the recolour ratio then multiplies that gap. assets/ball.ts now uses k.tint(slot, -0.06 * (1 - sheen)), a multiply. assets/kite.ts returns the pure slot colour with a crisp cream binding and cross. assets/brush.ts paints every bristle with the paint slot and grows the bristle radius by 20 percent. The diff holds no change to variants or presets, so no pin entry moves. The ball mean default texel is #d64339 against the slot #d9443a (redyellow mean error 2.7, was 29.6).
